text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A and Stock E for modest gains, but a gain relative to my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should judge each decision by the stock’s prospects and my overall portfolio.","Selling Stock D after a large gain felt good, but I should not treat realized gains as more valuable than unrealized ones or assume past price moves predict what comes next.","I made no trades in Periods 3–5, and that was a valid choice; I should trade only when it serves a clear purpose, not just because I check my account often."]}
